title: MeshPress: STRIDE — STRIp-walked Triangulated Residual Integer Decoder for Per-Meshlet GPU Mesh Compression
description: Reference implementation of STRIDE, a per-meshlet self-contained mesh compression format designed for per-frame GPU decompression, with the encoder, fused CUDA decoder, bitstream specification, eight-mesh benchmark harness, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure in the accompanying article in The Visual Computer (Springer).
